[FACT] User is looking to get a new grill and is considering a Weber.  
[PREFERENCE] User's neighbor has a Weber grill that distributes heat evenly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Weber is an excellent choice, known for high-quality products and excellent performance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommendations for first-time buyers include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Weber Genesis II Series: Offers excellent performance, durability, and versatility.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Weber Spirit Series: A more affordable option, great for smaller families or limited outdoor space.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Weber Original Kettle Grill: A classic charcoal-fueled grill for a traditional grilling experience.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for first-time buyers include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Determine your needs based on the number of people and type of food.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Decide on fuel type: gas, propane, natural gas, or charcoal.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Ensure the grill fits comfortably in your outdoor space.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Consider additional features like number of burners, grilling surface area, and storage space.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Set a budget and stick to it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Check warranty and customer support.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Read reviews and research before purchasing.  
[PREFERENCE] User is experimenting with smoking meats and has purchased a smoker box for their gas grill.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Smoker attachments for gas grills include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Smoker Tubes: Long, hollow tubes for wood chips or pellets.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Smoker Baskets: Larger, rectangular boxes for wood chips.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Pellet Smoker Attachments: Use wood pellets for precise temperature control.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Ceramic Smoker Elements: Absorb heat and release smoky flavor.
